title: Canonical JSON test vector
description: Format of test-vectors/canonical-json/*.json. canonical = JCS(input) for operation=canonicalize, or JCS(input without its top-level "hash" member) for operation=object_hash; sha256 = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonical. See docs/canonical-json.md.

expected_kind.description: object_hash only: the kind the verifier expects at this position; a different kind is INVALID_KIND.
